instruction: A glass-and-iron Victorian conservatory filled with plants: rows of potted palms, ferns and broad-leaf tropicals on tiered benches, hanging baskets, a brick path, a watering can and garden tools, and a small fountain at the center. Sunlight streams through the glazed roof ribs, and dust motes drift in the light shafts while leaves sway gently.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Victorian Greenhouse Conservatory. A glass-and-iron Victorian conservatory filled with plants: rows of potted palms, ferns and broad-leaf tropicals on tiered benches, hanging baskets, a brick path, a watering can and garden tools, and a small fountain at the center. Sunlight streams through the glazed roof ribs, and dust motes drift in the light shafts while leaves sway gently. Style: lush stylized realism. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
